verdict.rationale: DeepSeek keeps a first-party News/updates changelog at api-docs.deepseek.com/updates. It records dated model and API changes: new model availability (V4.1 Flash, V4-Flash-Vision-Exp), API format additions (Responses API), and deprecation notices with three months' advance warning and alias mapping for legacy model names. Missing for 10: no evidence of a subscribable feed (RSS/email) for following changes, no independent corroboration of how consistently the changelog is maintained.

support.subject: As a developer, model and API changes land in a maintained changelog or release notes I can follow

citations.quote: The two legacy API model names, `deepseek-chat` and `deepseek-reasoner`, will be discontinued in three months (2026-07-24).
The DeepSeek API now natively supports the OpenAI Responses API format
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is now available on the DeepSeek API with native multimodal support.
the new multimodal vision understanding model DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp is now available on the DeepSeek API platform
